moments.text: IR view with a cyan crosshair looking down on scattered white clouds over a darker sea; the crosshair sits on a clear patch.
After a dark frame the view zooms in: clouds drift past, and a faint short dash hovers just left of the crosshair.
White, black and flat grey frames for ~0.4 s as the sensor zooms in again.
A long curved line of bright dots appears lower right and slides up-left across the crosshair, leaving the top-left edge by 32.6 s.
The line re-enters at the upper left and the sensor swings onto it; it then holds in the lower frame as cloud banks slide through.
The line of dots stays just below the crosshair, thinning and fading against the sea and clouds until only a faint arc is left.
